name: public-proteingym-sequence-evolution-structure
hypothesis: Sequence/evolution averaging improved PR-AUC on 161 of 185 discovery proteins. Add ESM-IF1 inverse-folding likelihood as a distinct structural-compatibility constraint, since plausible evolutionary sequences can still destabilize the specific fold. Equal normalized weights; the fixed ESM-IF1 range gives more variation than the two other scores, a known risk accepted without tuning. This tests whether the structural mechanism transfers across heterogeneous assay endpoints.
